justification: Thin wiring PR: one FastAPI endpoint over the already-QA'd #742 engine, a Next.js proxy route, and flag-gated UI components that render nothing until BOTH env flags are on. No DB access, no change to any existing behaviour while dark; silent wrong output at the endpoint boundary matters (standard), nothing can corrupt data (not critical).

pre_impl.existing_data: Consumes the assembled brief the frontend already holds from the Trigger.dev stream (no re-fetch, per frontend reuse rule); calls generate_overlay from #742; reads no database.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the streamed section shapes drift from the server brief shape, build_manifest inside the engine walks what it can and the overlay degrades to fewer rows or None — never an error on the brief page.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Everything is dark until BOTH NEXT_PUBLIC_BRIEF_LLM_OVERLAY_ENABLED (Vercel build) and BRIEF_LLM_OVERLAY_ENABLED (Railway) are true; with either off the page renders byte-identically to today.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Anthropic failures are already converted to overlay=null by the engine; proxy failures return enabled:false; the UI renders nothing for both.
pre_impl.frontend_type: New BriefOverlay/OverlayLine types in BriefIntentOverlay.tsx mirror RenderedOverlay JSON; tsc clean (0 errors), jest 768 passed.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: User sees the normal brief with no overlay card; failures logged server-side only.

functions.name: brief_overlay
functions.input: OverlayRequest with assembled brief dict, persona, optional intent and question
functions.output: OverlayResponse with enabled flag and overlay dict or null
functions.if_none: flag off returns enabled:false without touching the engine; engine returning None yields enabled:true overlay:null so the UI shows nothing

functions.name: _persona_known
functions.input: persona string from the request body before any processing
functions.output: the same string when it is a known persona value
functions.if_none: unknown persona fails pydantic validation and the request is rejected 422 at the gate

functions.name: _intent_known
functions.input: optional intent string from the request body
functions.output: the same value when null or a recognised Intent enum value
functions.if_none: null passes through (no intent chosen yet); unknown intent strings are rejected 422 before reaching the engine

functions.name: _brief_not_empty
functions.input: the brief dict posted back by the frontend
functions.output: the same dict when it carries at least an address
functions.if_none: an empty or address-less dict is rejected 422 so the engine never walks garbage

values.if_missing: endpoint answers enabled:false overlay:null and never calls the engine — the fail-safe default
proxy answers enabled:false overlay:null locally instead of throwing on a bad fetch URL
null until the brief completes; the card renders nothing and no fetch fires

break_it.scenario: Operator believes the overlay is off but the endpoint serves it anyway because the flag check lives only client-side
break_it.what_happens: Audiences that opted out would receive LLM-selected content against the user-confirmed default-off decision
break_it.how: services/brief_overlay_api.py:91 — server-side flag check answers enabled:false without calling the engine, asserted with a mock that the engine is never invoked

break_it.scenario: A garbage or address-less brief body reaches the engine and produces a confident-looking empty overlay
break_it.what_happens: The card could render misleading near-empty content for a request that was never a valid brief
break_it.how: services/brief_overlay_api.py:70 — request validators reject unknown persona, unknown intent, oversize question, and address-less briefs with 422

break_it.scenario: An engine exception at the endpoint boundary leaks a stack trace or breaks the brief page fetch
break_it.what_happens: The brief page fetch would surface an opaque 500 body and could log user data in tracebacks
break_it.how: services/brief_overlay_api.py:103 — belt-and-braces handler returns a fixed 500 detail; the UI treats any non-ok as render-nothing

break_it.scenario: Railway answers the overlay proxy with a 503 while the user's completed brief is already on screen
break_it.what_happens: A user who already received their full brief would see an error banner caused by the optional overlay layer
break_it.how: frontend-nextjs/app/api/brief-overlay/route.ts:44 returns enabled:false on any failure and BriefIntentOverlay.tsx catch renders nothing — additive-only in both layers
break_it.repro: stop Railway locally and confirm the brief page still completes with no overlay card

break_it.scenario: Switching intent chips races two fetches and a stale response overwrites the newer plan
break_it.what_happens: The card would show facts selected for the previously chosen intent under the new chip
break_it.how: frontend-nextjs/components/reports/BriefIntentOverlay.tsx:131 — effect keyed on address+intent with an ignore-flag cleanup discards stale responses
break_it.repro: toggle two chips rapidly with network throttling and confirm the rendered card matches the last chip

post_merge.secrets: No — reuses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY already on Railway
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — to preview: set BRIEF_LLM_OVERLAY_ENABLED=true on Railway and NEXT_PUBLIC_BRIEF_LLM_OVERLAY_ENABLED=true on a Vercel preview env, then run a brief and pick an intent chip
